notes.title: New Release - Dawn of War II: Retribution – The Last Standalone
notes.notes:
The popular survival game mode from Dawn of War II, Dawn of War II: Retribution – The Last Standalone, is now available as a stand-alone game on Steam!

Dawn of War II: Retribution – The Last Standalone is a cooperative survival mode where you control a single hero and face off against waves of enemies with two other teammates.  Choose from one of the six available heroes and gain experience points to level up and unlock new wargear and abilities.

Dawn of War II: Retribution owners already have The Last Standalone and do not need to purchase it separately.
